stem: Extra peninsular mountains of India were formed during
expl: The extra-peninsular mountains of India (the region north of the Indus and Ganga plains), including the Himalayas, were formed during the Cenozoic Era.

stem: dandakaranya region lies in the state of:

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above / More than one of the above

expl: Dandakaranya is located in the central part of India; it is mainly spread across Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh. However, a small part of the Dandakaranya region also falls in Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra.

stem: Which one of the following is not a part of the Meghalaya Plateau?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: The Bhuban Hills (also spelled as Bhuvan Hills) are a part of the Mizo Hills, which belong to the Eastern Hills region, whereas the Garo, Khasi, and Jaintia Hills are parts of the Meghalaya Plateau.

stem: The ‘Malnad’ region is related to which of the following plateaus of India?

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: The Malnad region is related to the Karnataka Plateau of southern India. It is associated with the plateau region adjoining the Western Ghats.

stem: India’s territorial limit extends towards the sea up to how many nautical miles/km from the coast?

options.label: d
options.text: More than one of the above

expl: According to the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, 1982, each coastal country may claim a territorial sea extending up to 12 nautical miles (21.9 km) from its baseline. The coastal state exercises sovereignty over the airspace above this area and over the seabed and subsoil beneath it.

expl: The Lakshadweep Islands are an atoll island group located in the Arabian Sea off the south-western coast of India.

stem: Lakshadweep consists of how many islands?
expl: Lakshadweep is a group of islands located in the Arabian Sea at a distance of about 220–440 km from the Kochi coast of Kerala. It is a Union Territory of India with a total area of 32 sq km. Most of the islands are of coral origin. The total number of islands in the Lakshadweep group is 36. The northernmost inhabited island is Chetlat, and the southernmost island is Minicoy, which is separated from the remaining islands by the 9° Channel. Kavaratti is the capital of Lakshadweep. The largest island is Andrott.
